verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for an online business-filing portal, since such a service could offer a conversational assistant. Nothing in the pack shows one: SOSPortal is described only as a conventional web portal with forms, drafts, a shopping cart and a My Submissions page. The filing host's robots.txt also bans AI agents such as GPTBot and ChatGPT-User by name, which points away from agent-driven use.
